question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct option is: **awakened**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that it seemed as though that voice suddenly brought unexpected life to the whole scene in front of them
 
• The word** "awakened" ****(जागा) **fits the blank because it conveys the idea of bringing the scene to life or reviving it.
 
• The voice is described as infusing the scene with unexpected life, and "awakened" captures the sense of vitality being introduced into the surroundings.

Hence, the correct answer is: **awakened**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Belated (देरी से आना): **This means something that is delayed or happening later than expected. It does not fit the context, as it does not imply bringing the scene to life.
 
• **Lapsed (समाप्त होना):** This means something that has fallen into disuse or has passed beyond its original point. It does not fit the context of bringing life to the scene.
 
• **Untried (अपरिक्षित):** This means something that has not been tested or experimented with. It does not convey the sense of bringing life to the scene.
